﻿Stream LA Campaign Requirements
________________


Requirements
* Post on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube. 9:16 vertical format.
* Every clip must have an onscreen title.
* Vary your captions. Do not reuse the same line across posts.
* Use CTA in every clip including on screen 
* Tag the correct cast member in every clip. See the strategy doc for handles.
* Use these hashtags on every post: #streamhouselacwe  #streamhousela  #cwetv  #chickenwrapentertainment
* No botting or fake engagement.
* No personal watermarks.
* Must target USA, UK and Canada. If you struggle on reaching target audience reach out to admin. 
________________


Account Creation
Already have a streamer or entertainment theme page with 5,000+ followers? You can use it. If not, set up a dedicated account before your first post.
Step 1: Username
Pick something that reads as a general streaming or entertainment clips page. Examples: cwedailyplug, streamlaclips, dailycwetvmoments. Ask ChatGPT for more ideas if needed.
Step 2: Profile picture
Use a clean entertainment-themed image. Keep it professional.
Step 3: Bio
Two parts, in this order:
* One short line about Stream LA in your own words, so every account's bio is different.
* Tag the show on each platform: @streamhousela on TikTok and Instagram.
Step 4: Warm up your account
Wait 24 hours before posting. During that time, follow accounts, like, and comment on entertainment, reality TV, and streaming content only. This tells the algorithm what your page is about before your first clip goes up.
________________


Story Posts
You must post a story on both Instagram and TikTok for every clip.
Instagram story: use this link — https://www.cwenetwork.com/buy?campaign=motionclipping
TikTok story: use the QR code provided: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rY8qEjLsF-hlztbKBRWSedyR660EHePh/view?usp=drive_link




________________


How To Get Paid
1. Post with the correct tags and story.
2. Copy the post link.
3. Submit it in the Content Rewards tab on Whop.
4. Paid to your Whop balance 4 days after approval.

=== DOC 1NFNw6TZ91CNBRB0SAT2GfyIbiBxjJisdWsu4CAB3zVo ===
﻿Stream LA  Creator Content Strategy
Everything you need to make approved clips for this campaign. Read the whole doc before posting.
1. Campaign Overview
Stream LA is a show on CWETV. Your job is to clip the strongest moments from each episode and post them on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube. The goal is to build curiosity. Viewers should encounter different Stream LA moments, personalities, drama, and reactions until they want to watch the full episodes on CWETV.
Clips should feel organic and entertaining, not promotional. Content should feel like something a viewer naturally discovered on their feed.
Awareness. Conversation. Curiosity. CWETV viewers.
2. Content Formats
There are two approved formats. Rotate between them.
Episode Clips (priority format)
Pull the strongest moments directly from each new episode. The goal is to make someone curious about what happens before and after.
* Arguments, confrontations, strong reactions
* Quotable lines and personality moments
* Drama, tension, unexpected turns
* Relationships, flirting, interactions between cast
* Anything that makes viewers comment
Example: https://www.tiktok.com/@cweplug/video/7703206759887850773?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc


Hook within the first 2 seconds. Fast-moving, subtitled, social-first.
Meme Style
Take a reaction, line, or moment from the show and frame it around a universal feeling. Should feel like something a viewer would send to a friend. The show is the backdrop. The feeling is the hook.
* POV captions and "when you..." 
* Text-over-reaction clips
* Relatable group chat or friend group moments
Example: https://www.tiktok.com/@cwedailyplug/video/7697018712385342723?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc


Make sure there is a CWETV CTA in the description and on screen
3. Titles & Hooks
Every clip must have an onscreen title. Vary them. Do not reuse the same title across posts.
Each beginning of your video should start off strong with a slight build up in 3-5 secs to catch the viewers attention. 
Episode clip title examples:
* India Love CRASHED OUT After Vegas Ky Did THIS!
* Vegas Ky Falls In LOVE With Michaela After She Says THIS On Stream!
* India Love makes Michaela fall in love with Vegas Ky after seeing him with his ex!
Meme style title examples:
* POV: fine shyt catches you staring now your tryna act lost 
* When you tell yourself your scoring buckets tonight but go home with no numbers in your phone
* Me crashing out after seeing my ex’s replacement
* POV you start falling in love after you told yourself you will never fall in love again
* That one person in every friend group that acts weird in front of the huzz
* The way i start frying my homie in front of the huzz 
4. CTAs
Include one CTA in every caption. Rotate. Do not repeat the same one back to back.
* Watch Streamhouse LA on CWETV
* Download CWETV to watch the full episode
* Watch the full episode 2 on CWETV
* Episode 2 officially out now on https://chickenwrapent.com


When someone comments asking where to watch, reply immediately with the CWETV link. Do not leave it unanswered.

New episodes drop every Monday at 6:00 PM starting October 12. Shift your content to the new episode each week. Your new posts should pull from the current episode, not older ones.
